subject: packrat::snapshot() fails when fetching source on packages from local repository

messages.author: 61221ab1f726dce8
messages.subject: packrat::snapshot() fails when fetching source on packages from local repository
parts:
Hi,

I've install several packages to a local repository (similar to how I did it in this post). I was able to run packrat::install_local() on these packages. But I noticed that the snapshots were not being updated.

So I explicitly ran packrat::snapshot(), and ran into these errors:

> packrat::snapshot()


Adding these packages to packrat:

    tidyr        0.2.0
    vimcom       1.0-0
    whisker      0.3-2




Upgrading these packages already present in packrat:
                  from        to
    Rcpp        0.11.2    0.11.3
    dplyr          0.2   0.3.0.2
    magrittr     1.0.1       1.5
    packrat    0.4.1-1   0.4.2-1


Fetching sources for colorout (1.0-3) ... Fetching sources for vimcom (1.0-0) ... Error in snapshotSources(project, activeRepos(project), allRecordsFlat) :
  Errors occurred when fetching source files:
Error : Command failed (1)


The command failed with output:
* checking for file '/home/fong/R/packages/colorout/DESCRIPTION' ... OK
* preparing 'colorout':
* checking DESCRIPTION meta-information ... OK
Warning in file(con, "r") :
  cannot open file 'man': No such file or directory
Error in file(con, "r") : cannot open the connection
 ERROR
computing Rd index failed
Error : Command failed (1)


The command failed with output:
* checking for file '/home/fong/R/packages/vimcom/DESCRIPTION' ... OK
* preparing 'vimcom':
* checking DESCRIPTION meta-information ... OK
Warning in file(con, "r") :
  cannot open file 'man': No such file or directory
Error in file(con, "r") : cannot open the connection
 ERROR
computing Rd index failed

Both colorout and vimcom are the packages that I've installed locally in ~/R/packages. Any help would be appreciated.

Thanks,

messages.author: ab0d2be2ea8dabe8
messages.subject: Re: packrat::snapshot() fails when fetching source on packages from local repository
parts:
Hi TinyHeero,

I apologize! I mislead you in my earlier recommendations. The way local repositories work in Packrat is that it’s just a folder of (untarred) package sources. What you really want to be doing is placing the package sources, not an installed package tarball, into your ~/R/packages folder.

(If you are already using that folder as a library, ie, directory full of installed packages, you might want to use e.g. ~/R/package-sources or something similar.

Here’s a script that can fix things up:

packrat::opts$local.repos("~/r/package-sources")
dir.create("~/r/package-sources")
download.file("http://www.lepem.ufc.br/jaa/old/vimcom_1.0-0.tar.gz", destfile = "vimcom_1.0-0.tar.gz")
localRepoDir <- normalizePath("~/r/package-sources")
untar("vimcom_1.0-0.tar.gz", exdir = localRepoDir)
packrat::install_local("vimcom")

packrat::snapshot()

The main difference is that we simply untar, rather than install, the package into the ‘local repository’ directory.

Thanks, and sorry about the earlier misinformation!
Kevin
